frozen.body:
An inspection documented the violations listed below. The compliance deadlines remain those in the Official Notice.

We are issuing a citation for the documented violation. Please see the included Court Citation document for more information.

Once you finish the work, schedule a reinspection with your inspector. If you do not complete the work and contact the inspector by the new due date, we may:

  • Issue a citation; or
  • Send the case to the City Attorney’s Office for legal action/prosecution.

Contact your inspector right away if you have questions.
frozen.courtInstructions:
No in-person appearance is required. You may enter a plea of guilty, no contest, or not guilty via email, regular mail, fax or telephone on or before the assigned court date on your citation(s) or complaint. Contact information for submitting your plea is below.

IF YOU WANT TO PLEAD NOT GUILTY: DO NOT APPEAR in person on your assigned court date. If you choose to plead not guilty, the court will schedule a telephone pretrial conference with the Madison City Attorney just as if you had appeared in person and entered your plea. A pretrial is where you attempt to negotiate an agreement with the prosecutor. If you are able to reach a settlement with the prosecutor at the telephone pretrial, the court will review and likely approve the agreement. If you are not able to reach an agreement with the prosecutor, the court will set the case for a trial and send you a notice of the trial date.

IF YOU WANT TO PLEAD GUILTY OR NO CONTEST: You can plead guilty or no contest without appearing in court. If you wish to plead guilty or no contest, a judgment will be ordered on the charge(s) described in the citation(s)/complaint. The Judge will set the penalty within the minimum and maximum allowed by law. You may provide a written statement about mitigating factors you want the court to take into consideration for sentencing purposes. Payment will be due in 90 days from your assigned court date unless you request a payment plan with the court. You can also mail in the payment amount listed on the citation(s) on or before your assigned court date and it will be considered as a no contest plea by the court. If you choose to appear in court, you will be required to follow safety protocols.

IF YOU DO NOT ENTER A PLEA OR MAIL IN PAYMENT ON OR BEFORE YOUR ASSIGNED COURT DATE: The court will enter an order of conviction on the charge(s) against you and inform you of what you must pay and other legal sanctions that may apply to your case.

You must notify the court of any change of address that is different than what is listed on your citation(s) or complaint. For additional questions or concerns please visit the Madison Municipal Court website at www.cityofmadison.com/municipalcourt or contact the court directly:
